CI run #1 failed on all 3 python versions: in module mode on a bare runner the pre-commit hook finds no tenx and fails open, so the git-gate block tests failed. Fix: module mode now installs a PATH shim running the source tree — hermetic, no install needed. Verified locally with tenx stripped from PATH.

CI flake hunt: smoke git-gate checks now carry full self-diagnostics (git pipeline replay, staged files, HEAD ts, entry timestamps) so any future runner-side failure explains itself; hardened commit-without-writeback --since to whole-second ISO dates.

Root cause of CI py3.10 failure found and fixed: on UTC hosts git renders %aI with a trailing Z (2026-08-26T11:08:52Z); Python 3.10 datetime.fromisoformat rejects Z (3.11+ accepts), so commit-without-writeback and gate commit-check silently failed open. Fix: shared parse_git_ts() normalizes Z -> +00:00. Smoke now commits gateproj in TZ=UTC to regression-test the Z shape on every python; negative-tested locally (revert reproduces CI failure on 3.10, fix clears it).
